"""Exact source-gated Native NRS 484B.400(1) T-junction entrypoint."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from package_spec import AID, ACTOR, CAMERA_NAMES, CELL, LAW
from native_turn_construction import construct


def reviewed_site(path, case):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    site = json.loads(path.read_text())
    request = construct(site, case)
    if site.get("rate_hz") != 20 or site.get("duration_frames") != 900 or tuple(site.get("cameras", ())) != CAMERA_NAMES:
        raise ValueError("original 20 Hz four-view profile required")
    refs = site.get("source_refs")
    roles = {"map", "public_highway", "non_alley_intersection", "lane_design",
             "qualification_223_4", "connected_right_exit", "driver_identity",
             "intended_right_turn", "vehicle_spawn", "approach_trajectory",
             "turn_trajectory", "turn_lane_connectors"}
    if not isinstance(refs, list) or not roles <= {item.get("role") for item in refs}:
        raise ValueError("complete separately sourced highway, conditional lane and route facts required")
    for ref in refs:
        target = (path.parent / ref["path"]).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(path.parent) or not target.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("reviewed source hash changed: " + ref.get("role", "unknown"))
    if site["map_sha256"] != next(ref["sha256"] for ref in refs if ref["role"] == "map"):
        raise ValueError("Native map source differs")
    site["reviewed_site_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return site, request


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--site", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host")
    parser.add_argument("--port")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "config.json").read_text())
    case = config["selected_case_id"]
    if (config["assignment_id"], config["law_id"], config["cell_id"], config["actor"]) != (AID, LAW, CELL, ACTOR) or args.case not in (None, case):
        raise ValueError("exact selected right-turn position case differs")
    if args.check:
        print("exact right-turn position runner static check passed: " + case)
        return
    site_path = args.site or os.environ.get("C399695_REVIEWED_4001_SITE")
    if not site_path or not args.host or not args.port or args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed Native T-junction site, host, port and output required")
    site, request = reviewed_site(site_path, case)
    from turn_carla_adapter import CarlaRightTurnAdapter
    from turn_capture import capture
    capture(CarlaRightTurnAdapter(args.host, args.port, site, request,
                                  config.get("control_profile", {})), site, case, args.output_dir)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Materialized case identity and source-gated runner smoke test."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class BundleTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_case_static_runner(self):
        config = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
        self.assertTrue(config["selected_case_id"].startswith(config["assignment_id"] + "__"))
        self.assertEqual((config["rate_hz"], config["duration_s"]), (20, 45))
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runner.py"), "--check"],
                                cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("static check passed", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Saved-only finalizer for original approach and right-turn lane position."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from package_spec import CAMERA_NAMES
from turn_position import measure


def _need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _source(root, name):
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]


def source_sealed_turn_position(value):
    return value


def analyze(attempt):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads(_source(root, "config.json").read_text())
    case = config["selected_case_id"]
    receipt = json.loads(_source(root, "original-source-receipt.json").read_text())
    diagnostic = receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True
    _need(receipt.get("source_kind") == ("synthetic_diagnostic_fixture" if diagnostic else "original_native_capture")
          and receipt.get("case_id") == case, "exact original/diagnostic source receipt differs")
    paths = {name: _source(root, name) for name in
             ("turn-position-history.json", "turn-position-measurement.json", "trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")}
    for field, name in (("history_sha256", "turn-position-history.json"),
                        ("measurement_sha256", "turn-position-measurement.json"),
                        ("trace_sha256", "trace.jsonl"), ("frame_map_sha256", "video_frames.jsonl")):
        _need(receipt.get(field) == _sha(paths[name]), "sealed turn-position source differs: " + field)
    history = json.loads(paths["turn-position-history.json"].read_text())
    trace, mapping = _rows(paths["trace.jsonl"]), _rows(paths["video_frames.jsonl"])
    samples = history["samples"]
    _need(history.get("assignment_id") == config["assignment_id"] and history.get("case_id") == case and
          len(samples) == len(trace) == len(mapping) and len(samples) >= 4,
          "turn-position original source identity/count differs")
    frames = []
    for index, (row, motion, mapped) in enumerate(zip(samples, trace, mapping)):
        _need(row["frame"] == mapped["video_frame"] == index and
              row["native_frame"] == row["original_frame"] == mapped["native_frame"] == mapped["carla_frame"] == motion["frame"] and
              row["time_s"] == mapped["time_s"] == motion["time_s"] and
              row["driver_id"] == history["driver_actor_id"] and
              row["position_xyz_m"] == motion["position_m"] and
              abs(row["speed_mps"] - motion["speed_mps"]) < 1e-6,
              "original frame, motion, body or driver join differs")
        frames.append({key: row[key] for key in
                       ("original_frame", "time_s", "driver_id", "road_id", "lane_id",
                        "junction_id", "phase", "source_ref", "position_xyz_m")})
    site = {key: history[key] for key in
            ("map_sha256", "public_highway_source", "intersection_source",
             "right_lane_design_source", "qualification_223_4_source",
             "connected_right_exit_source", "turn_phase_lane_source",
             "turn_phase_lane_refs", "driver_identity_source", "entry_road_id",
             "right_exit_road_id", "junction_id", "turn_lane_id", "extreme_right_lane_id",
             "public_highway", "non_alley_intersection", "t_intersection",
             "connected_right_exit", "right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4")}
    site["source_id"] = history["reviewed_site_sha256"]
    site["driver_id"] = history["driver_actor_id"]
    measured = measure(site, frames, history["intended_maneuver"])
    _need(json.loads(paths["turn-position-measurement.json"].read_text()) == measured,
          "turn-position measurement differs from original frames")
    values = {
        "intersection_and_highway": {"public_highway": history["public_highway"],
                                     "non_alley_intersection": history["non_alley_intersection"],
                                     "connected_right_exit": history["connected_right_exit"]},
        "conditional_lane_qualification": {"qualifying_right_turn_lane": measured["qualifying_right_turn_lane"],
                                           "conditional_lane_id": measured["conditional_lane_id"],
                                           "required_turn_phase_lane_refs": measured["required_turn_phase_lane_refs"]},
        "extreme_right_alternative": {"qualifying_right_turn_lane": measured["qualifying_right_turn_lane"],
                                       "extreme_right_lane_id": history["extreme_right_lane_id"],
                                       "conditional_lane_id": measured["conditional_lane_id"]},
        "driver_and_intention": {"driver_id": history["driver_actor_id"],
                                 "intention_source": measured["intention_source"]},
        "approach_lane_position": {"lane_ids": measured["approach_lane_ids"],
                                   "original_frames": measured["approach_original_frames"],
                                   "entirely_from_required_lane": measured["approach_entirely_from_required_lane"]},
        "turn_lane_position": {"lane_ids": measured["turn_lane_ids"],
                               "original_frames": measured["turn_original_frames"],
                               "entirely_from_required_lane": measured["turn_entirely_from_required_lane"]},
        "connected_departure": {"right_exit_road_id": history["right_exit_road_id"],
                                "observed_exit_road_id": samples[-1]["road_id"]},
    }
    source_hashes = {name: _sha(_source(root, name)) for name in
                     ("turn-position-history.json", "original-source-receipt.json", "trace.jsonl")}
    measurements = {name: {"method": "source_sealed_turn_position",
                           "value": source_sealed_turn_position(value),
                           "sources": source_hashes} for name, value in values.items()}
    evidence = []
    for channel in config["case"]["recording_description"]["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        path = root / ("channel-" + name + ".jsonl")
        content = "".join(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value":
                                      row["lane_id"] if name in ("approach_lane_position", "turn_lane_position") else
                                      row["road_id"] if name == "connected_departure" else values[name]}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
                          for row in samples)
        if path.exists():
            _need(path.read_text() == content, "derived channel differs from saved source")
        else:
            path.write_text(content)
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": path.name})
    context = root / "channel-reviewed_t_junction_site.json"
    content = json.dumps({"reviewed_t_junction_site": {
        "reviewed_site_sha256": history["reviewed_site_sha256"],
        "qualification_source": history["qualification_223_4_source"]}}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    if context.exists():
        _need(context.read_text() == content, "reviewed site context differs")
    else:
        context.write_text(content)
    evidence.append({"name": "reviewed_t_junction_site", "unit": "source record",
                     "reference": context.name})
    target = {"target": "measured right-turn approach and turn lane position",
              "requested": config["case"]["case_id"],
              "measured": {"approach": measured["approach_entirely_from_required_lane"],
                           "turn": measured["turn_entirely_from_required_lane"]},
              "method": "original Native joined lane/road/pose and independent qualification source",
              "tolerance": 0, "matched": True,
              "physical_cause_confirmed": False, "cause_evidence": source_hashes}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
    result = {"case_id": case, "measured_values": values, "target_checks": [target],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
              "maneuver_completed": False, "termination_reason": "saved physical and source review pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["physical_acceptance_unverified"],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERA_NAMES],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": config["case"]["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {},
              "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
              "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    write_result(root, result)
    return {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case,
            "analysis_complete": True, "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
            "measurements": measurements, "physical_checks": result["physical_checks"],
            "realized_observables": result["realized_observables"],
            "limitations": ["Measured lane intervals and reviewed design are observations, not a legal verdict."]}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior analysis report")
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(analyze(args.attempt), indent=2) + "\n")

"""Source-bound observations for NRS 484B.400(1) at a T junction.

The approach and the right turn are separate measured intervals.  The
right-turn-lane qualification is a reviewed source fact, never inferred from
lane occupancy or a painted arrow in a synthetic fixture.
"""

import math


def _need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _finite(value):
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)


def validate_site(site):
    for key in ("source_id", "map_sha256", "public_highway_source", "intersection_source",
                "right_lane_design_source", "qualification_223_4_source",
                "connected_right_exit_source", "turn_phase_lane_source",
                "driver_identity_source", "driver_id",
                "entry_road_id", "right_exit_road_id", "junction_id", "turn_lane_id"):
        _need(site.get(key), "missing original site source: " + key)
    _need(site.get("public_highway") is True and site.get("non_alley_intersection") is True,
          "public-highway non-alley intersection source required")
    _need(site.get("t_intersection") is True and site.get("connected_right_exit") is True,
          "connected T-junction right exit source required")
    _need(type(site.get("right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4")) is bool,
          "reviewed NRS 484B.223(4) lane qualification required")
    _need(site["entry_road_id"] != site["right_exit_road_id"],
          "right exit must be a distinct connected road")
    _need(site.get("extreme_right_lane_id") is not None,
          "source-surveyed extreme-right lane required")
    if site["right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4"]:
        _need(site["extreme_right_lane_id"] != site["turn_lane_id"],
              "separate extreme-right lane required for the controlled comparison")
    refs = site.get("turn_phase_lane_refs")
    _need(isinstance(refs, dict) and set(refs) == {"turn", "extreme"},
          "source-surveyed junction connector lane references required")
    for key, lane_id in (("turn", site["turn_lane_id"]),
                         ("extreme", site["extreme_right_lane_id"])):
        pairs = refs[key]
        _need(isinstance(pairs, list) and pairs and all(
            isinstance(pair, list) and len(pair) == 2 and
            all(type(value) is int for value in pair) for pair in pairs),
            "invalid original junction connector road/lane references")
        _need([site["entry_road_id"], lane_id] in pairs,
              "junction connector map omits source-selected lane entry")


def measure(site, frames, intention):
    """Measure lane position during approach and turn from original frame rows."""
    validate_site(site)
    _need(intention.get("maneuver") == "right_turn" and intention.get("source_ref") and
          type(intention.get("declared_before_frame")) is int,
          "independent pre-approach right-turn intention required")
    _need(len(frames) >= 4, "original approach, turn and exit samples required")
    required = {"original_frame", "time_s", "driver_id", "road_id", "lane_id",
                "junction_id", "phase", "source_ref", "position_xyz_m"}
    for index, row in enumerate(frames):
        _need(not (required - row.keys()) and row["source_ref"],
              "missing original lane/phase/pose source")
        _need(row["driver_id"] == site["driver_id"], "driver identity mismatch")
        _need(type(row["original_frame"]) is int and _finite(row["time_s"]),
              "invalid original frame or time")
        _need(isinstance(row["position_xyz_m"], list) and len(row["position_xyz_m"]) == 3 and
              all(_finite(value) for value in row["position_xyz_m"]),
              "missing original body position")
        if index:
            previous = frames[index - 1]
            _need(previous["original_frame"] < row["original_frame"] and
                  previous["time_s"] < row["time_s"], "nonmonotone original frames")
    approach = [r for r in frames if r["phase"] == "approach"]
    turn = [r for r in frames if r["phase"] == "right_turn"]
    departure = [r for r in frames if r["phase"] == "departure"]
    _need(approach and turn and departure, "approach, turn and departure intervals required")
    _need(max(r["original_frame"] for r in approach) < min(r["original_frame"] for r in turn) and
          max(r["original_frame"] for r in turn) < min(r["original_frame"] for r in departure),
          "approach, turn and departure order differs")
    _need(intention["declared_before_frame"] < approach[0]["original_frame"],
          "right-turn intention not sourced before approach")
    _need(all(r["road_id"] == site["entry_road_id"] for r in approach) and
          all(r["junction_id"] == site["junction_id"] for r in turn) and
          all(r["road_id"] == site["right_exit_road_id"] for r in departure),
          "T-junction road and connected exit trace mismatch")
    required_lane = site["turn_lane_id"] if site["right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4"] else site["extreme_right_lane_id"]
    connector_key = "turn" if site["right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4"] else "extreme"
    allowed_turn_refs = site["turn_phase_lane_refs"][connector_key]
    return {
        "qualifying_right_turn_lane": site["right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4"],
        "conditional_lane_id": required_lane,
        "approach_lane_ids": [r["lane_id"] for r in approach],
        "turn_lane_ids": [r["lane_id"] for r in turn],
        "approach_entirely_from_required_lane": all(r["lane_id"] == required_lane for r in approach),
        "turn_entirely_from_required_lane": all([r["road_id"], r["lane_id"]] in allowed_turn_refs for r in turn),
        "required_turn_phase_lane_refs": allowed_turn_refs,
        "approach_original_frames": [r["original_frame"] for r in approach],
        "turn_original_frames": [r["original_frame"] for r in turn],
        "intention_source": intention["source_ref"],
        "site_sources": {key: site[key] for key in
                         ("public_highway_source", "intersection_source", "right_lane_design_source",
                          "qualification_223_4_source", "connected_right_exit_source",
                          "turn_phase_lane_source",
                          "driver_identity_source")},
        "frame_sources": list(dict.fromkeys(r["source_ref"] for r in frames)),
        "legal_verdict": None,
    }

"""Capture source-sealed Native approach, right turn and four lossless views."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

from package_spec import AID, CAMERA_NAMES
from turn_position import measure


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def capture(adapter, site, case, destination):
    destination = Path(destination).resolve()
    if destination.exists() or ".runtime-work" not in destination.parts or getattr(adapter, "native_attested", False) is not True:
        raise ValueError("attested original Native attempt belongs under fresh .runtime-work path")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="turn-position-original-", dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        adapter.configure()
        adapter.spawn()
        folders = {name: stage / ("frames-" + name) for name in CAMERA_NAMES}
        for folder in folders.values():
            folder.mkdir()
        from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
        frame_map = FrameMap(stage / "video_frames.jsonl")
        rows, mapping, trace = [], [], []
        prior = None
        for index in range(900):
            native_frame, native_time = adapter.tick()
            if type(native_frame) is not int or type(native_time) not in (float, int):
                raise ValueError("Native frame/time absent")
            if prior is not None and (native_frame != prior[0] + 1 or abs(native_time - prior[1] - .05) > .002):
                raise ValueError("Native 20 Hz frame/time continuity failed")
            prior = native_frame, native_time
            time_s = index / 20
            row = adapter.read(native_frame, time_s)
            if row.get("frame") != native_frame or row.get("time_s") != time_s or len(row.get("actor_ids", ())) != 1:
                raise ValueError("original Native vehicle and lane readback absent")
            images = adapter.pixels(native_frame)
            if set(images) != set(CAMERA_NAMES):
                raise ValueError("four original cameras required")
            hashes = {}
            for name in CAMERA_NAMES:
                raw = images[name].get("png")
                if images[name].get("frame") != native_frame or not isinstance(raw, bytes) or not raw.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
                    raise ValueError("camera frame or original pixels absent: " + name)
                (folders[name] / f"{index:04d}.png").write_bytes(raw)
                hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            row["native_frame"] = native_frame
            row["frame"] = index
            rows.append(row)
            mapping.append(frame_map.append(native_frame, time_s,
                                            camera_png_sha256=hashes))
            position = row["position_xyz_m"]
            trace.append({"frame": native_frame, "time_s": time_s,
                          "position_m": position,
                          "position": dict(zip(("x", "y", "z"), position)),
                          "heading_deg": row["heading_deg"],
                          "speed_mps": row["speed_mps"],
                          "speed_mph": row["speed_mps"] / .44704})
        frame_map.close()
        (stage / "trace.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in trace))
        history = {"source_kind": "original_native_actor_history", "assignment_id": AID,
                   "case_id": case, "reviewed_site_sha256": site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
                   "map_sha256": site["map_sha256"],
                   "public_highway_source": site["public_highway_source"],
                   "intersection_source": site["intersection_source"],
                   "right_lane_design_source": site["right_lane_design_source"],
                   "qualification_223_4_source": site["qualification_223_4_source"],
                   "connected_right_exit_source": site["connected_right_exit_source"],
                   "turn_phase_lane_source": site["turn_phase_lane_source"],
                   "turn_phase_lane_refs": site["turn_phase_lane_refs"],
                   "driver_identity_source": site["driver_identity_source"],
                   "driver_actor_id": site["driver_id"], "ego_actor_id": rows[0]["actor_ids"][0],
                   "public_highway": site["public_highway"],
                   "non_alley_intersection": site["non_alley_intersection"],
                   "t_intersection": site["t_intersection"],
                   "connected_right_exit": site["connected_right_exit"],
                   "right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4": site["right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4"],
                   "junction_id": site["junction_id"], "turn_lane_id": site["turn_lane_id"],
                   "extreme_right_lane_id": site["extreme_right_lane_id"],
                   "entry_road_id": site["entry_road_id"], "right_exit_road_id": site["right_exit_road_id"],
                   "intended_maneuver": site["intended_maneuver"],
                   "actor_ids": rows[0]["actor_ids"], "samples": rows}
        put(stage / "turn-position-history.json", history)
        probe_site = {key: history[key] for key in
                      ("map_sha256", "public_highway_source", "intersection_source",
                       "right_lane_design_source", "qualification_223_4_source",
                       "connected_right_exit_source", "turn_phase_lane_source",
                       "turn_phase_lane_refs", "driver_identity_source",
                       "entry_road_id", "right_exit_road_id", "junction_id",
                       "turn_lane_id", "extreme_right_lane_id", "public_highway",
                       "non_alley_intersection", "t_intersection", "connected_right_exit",
                       "right_turn_lane_qualified_under_223_4")}
        probe_site["source_id"] = site["source_id"]
        probe_site["driver_id"] = history["driver_actor_id"]
        frames = [{"original_frame": row["native_frame"], "time_s": row["time_s"],
                   "lane_id": row["lane_id"], "road_id": row["road_id"],
                   "junction_id": row["junction_id"], "phase": row["phase"],
                   "position_xyz_m": row["position_xyz_m"],
                   "source_ref": row["source_ref"], "driver_id": row["driver_id"]} for row in rows]
        try:
            measured = measure(probe_site, frames, history["intended_maneuver"])
        except ValueError as error:
            measured = {"measured": False, "physical_gap": str(error),
                        "legal_verdict": None}
        put(stage / "turn-position-measurement.json", measured)
        videos = {}
        for name, folder in folders.items():
            video = stage / (name + ".mkv")
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-framerate", "20",
                            "-i", str(folder / "%04d.png"), "-frames:v", "900",
                            "-c:v", "ffv1", str(video)], check=True,
                           stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            videos[name] = {"path": video.name, "sha256": sha(video), "frame_count": 900}
            shutil.rmtree(folder)
        put(stage / "original-source-receipt.json", {
            "source_kind": "original_native_capture", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "case_id": case, "fps": 20, "frame_count": 900,
            "reviewed_site_sha256": site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
            "history_sha256": sha(stage / "turn-position-history.json"),
            "trace_sha256": sha(stage / "trace.jsonl"),
            "frame_map_sha256": sha(stage / "video_frames.jsonl"),
            "measurement_sha256": sha(stage / "turn-position-measurement.json"),
            "cameras": videos, "physical_acceptance": False, "legal_verdict": None})
        os.replace(stage, destination)
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    finally:
        adapter.cleanup()

"""Lazy CARLA bridge for source-surveyed approach and turn trajectories."""

import hashlib
import io
import math
from queue import Queue

from package_spec import CAMERA_NAMES


class CarlaRightTurnAdapter:
    native_attested = True

    def __init__(self, host, port, site, request, profile):
        import carla
        self.carla = carla
        self.client = carla.Client(str(host), int(port))
        self.client.set_timeout(20)
        self.world = self.client.get_world()
        self.settings = self.world.get_settings()
        self.site, self.request, self.profile = site, request, profile
        self.owned, self.queues = [], {}
        self.ego = None
        self.path_index = 0

    def configure(self):
        native_map = self.world.get_map()
        if native_map.name != self.site["map_name"] or hashlib.sha256(native_map.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest() != self.site["map_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("original Native OpenDRIVE source differs")
        settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        self.world.apply_settings(settings)

    def spawn(self):
        item = self.site["native_spawn"]
        pose = item["pose_xyz_ypr"]
        c = self.carla
        transform = c.Transform(c.Location(x=pose[0], y=pose[1], z=pose[2]),
                                c.Rotation(pitch=pose[3], yaw=pose[4], roll=pose[5]))
        ego = self.world.try_spawn_actor(self.world.get_blueprint_library().find(item["blueprint_id"]), transform)
        if ego is None or not ego.id or ego.get_transform() is None:
            raise ValueError("source-pose Native vehicle spawn failed")
        self.ego = ego
        self.owned.append(ego)
        offsets = {"overview": (-18, 0, 20), "approach": (-9, 3, 5),
                   "reference_corner": (3, 4, 5), "driver_reference": (0, 0, 2)}
        for index, name in enumerate(CAMERA_NAMES):
            blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            width, height = ((1920, 1080) if index == 0 else (1280, 720))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(width))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(height))
            blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", "0.05")
            xyz = offsets[name]
            sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint,
                c.Transform(c.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2])), attach_to=ego)
            queue = Queue()
            sensor.listen(queue.put)
            self.owned.append(sensor)
            self.queues[name] = queue

    def tick(self):
        loc = self.ego.get_location()
        path = self.request["approach_trajectory_xy"] + self.request["turn_trajectory_xy"]
        while self.path_index < len(path) - 1 and math.hypot(loc.x - path[self.path_index][0], loc.y - path[self.path_index][1]) < 4:
            self.path_index += 1
        target = path[self.path_index]
        desired_yaw = math.degrees(math.atan2(target[1] - loc.y, target[0] - loc.x))
        yaw = self.ego.get_transform().rotation.yaw
        delta = (desired_yaw - yaw + 180) % 360 - 180
        velocity = self.ego.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)
        gain = float(self.profile.get("steer_gain", .025))
        if not .015 <= gain <= .04:
            raise ValueError("controller steering gain out of bounds")
        self.ego.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(
            throttle=max(0, min(.55, (8 - speed) * .18)),
            brake=max(0, min(.6, (speed - 8) * .2)),
            steer=max(-.7, min(.7, delta * gain))))
        frame = self.world.tick()
        snapshot = self.world.get_snapshot()
        if snapshot.frame != frame:
            raise ValueError("Native frame identity differs")
        return frame, snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds

    def read(self, frame, time_s):
        loc = self.ego.get_location()
        wp = self.world.get_map().get_waypoint(loc, project_to_road=False)
        if wp is None:
            raise ValueError("original Native lane/road waypoint absent")
        v = self.ego.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(v.x ** 2 + v.y ** 2 + v.z ** 2)
        if wp.road_id == self.site["right_exit_road_id"]:
            phase = "departure"
        elif wp.is_junction and wp.get_junction().id == self.site["junction_id"]:
            phase = "right_turn"
        else:
            phase = "approach"
        return {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "original_frame": frame,
                "actor_ids": [str(self.ego.id)], "driver_id": self.site["driver_id"],
                "lane_id": wp.lane_id, "road_id": wp.road_id,
                "junction_id": wp.get_junction().id if wp.is_junction else None,
                "phase": phase, "source_ref": self.site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
                "position_xyz_m": [loc.x, loc.y, loc.z],
                "heading_deg": self.ego.get_transform().rotation.yaw,
                "speed_mps": speed,
                "control": {"throttle": self.ego.get_control().throttle,
                            "brake": self.ego.get_control().brake,
                            "steer": self.ego.get_control().steer}}

    def pixels(self, frame):
        from PIL import Image
        images = {}
        for name in CAMERA_NAMES:
            image = self.queues[name].get(timeout=10)
            if image.frame != frame:
                raise ValueError("original camera frame differs: " + name)
            raw = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (image.width, image.height),
                                  bytes(image.raw_data), "raw", "BGRA")
            output = io.BytesIO()
            raw.convert("RGB").save(output, format="PNG")
            images[name] = {"frame": frame, "png": output.getvalue()}
        return images

    def cleanup(self):
        try:
            if self.ego is not None:
                self.ego.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(brake=1))
        finally:
            for actor in reversed(self.owned):
                try:
                    actor.destroy()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.world.apply_settings(self.settings)
